rooms.name: a small cloth bag
rooms.description:
It is a simple cloth bag used to hold things.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a recycling bin
rooms.description:
This is a blue trash can, marked with the letters "/dev/null".
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a giant cloth bag
rooms.description:
It is a simple cloth bag used to hold things.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: the newbie bin
rooms.description:
This medium-sized bin is designed to hold stuff that may be of use to newbies. By default it contains stuff that won't sell for much, but players are encouraged to make generous contributions for the benefit of weaker players. To view its contents: look in bin
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a large bin
rooms.description:
This a very large bin for holding donations to the needy. Since it is in a church, and for charity, it is reasonable to guess that folks above a certain level will receive a minor bonus for donating valuable things, and a severe penalty for taking them. There is a sign on the charity bin that you can read.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign on the bin you can read.

rooms.name: a wooden chest
rooms.description:
This is a sturdy wooden chest used to store valuable items.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a wooden chest
rooms.description:
This is a sturdy wooden chest used to store valuable items.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a cloth bag
rooms.description:
It is a simple cloth bag used to hold things.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a small mailbox
rooms.description:
This is a small mailbox standing in front of the white house.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a small cloth bag
rooms.description:
It is a simple cloth bag used to hold things. Printed on it is: "Property of A.S. Clepius"
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a small plastic bag
rooms.description:
It is a simple plastic bag used to hold things.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a metal safe
rooms.description:
This is a small safe, about 2 feet high, where one may store valuables. It looks quite strong.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a large stove
rooms.description:
This is a very large kitchen stove, which can handle quite a lot of food at once. The exterior is finished in a very tasteful brushed metal motif, and it seems that this is one of those expensive, imported stoves that only ridiculously rich people have in their homes.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

npcs.name: a rat
description: A scruffy little dirty rat.

rooms.name: a tall wooden wardrobe
rooms.description:
This piece of furniture is designed to hold clothing and related accessories.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a recycling bin
rooms.description:
This is a blue trash can, marked with the letters "/dev/null".
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a tall wooden wardrobe
rooms.description:
This piece of furniture is designed to hold clothing and related accessories.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a dusty chalkboard
rooms.description: This small building is where adventurers can record their adventures and leave messages and announcements for other brave souls. This is also the place one can seek advancement, so if you deserve to be a higher level adventurer, asking the guild master for it will make it so. A scroll lists quests one may perform, and a sign contains some instructions. The Creator's Hall is south of here. A special skills training area is upstairs. A conference room is east, where folks can discuss things in privacy.

npcs.name: Dirk the Tired
description: For 20 years, Dirk the Daring has been trying to defeat the vile dragon Singe, with almost no respite. Today he just wants to rest and relax, and has accepted the position of the town's Adventurers' Guild master. If you feel you deserve it, "ask dirk to advance".

scenery.name: list
description: A scroll hangs from the wall, listing some adventures you can perform which may have rewards for you.

scenery.name: sign
description: This sign contains some general instructions on how to gain experience and attain advancement.

scenery.name: building
description: You are in the Adventurers' Guild.

rooms.name: First Village Bank
rooms.description:
This simple place is the hub of financial activity for the village. Though not at all a fancy institution, this bank is trusted by the citizenry as being as safe as it gets for keeping their money.
A sign you can read hangs here.

npcs.name: Zoe the bank teller
description: Zoe is an attractive young blonde woman with a French accent. She is dressed in a conservative, executive style, and has a friendly and efficient air about her.
npcs.room_description: Zoe the bank teller is here.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign you can read.

scenery.name: bank
description: The primary financial institution in town.

rooms.name: The Church Basement
rooms.description:
This is the dark, musty basement of the village church. An elevator door is in the west wall.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

npcs.name: Leo the portly archwizard
description: Leo is a large, friendly-looking wizard with a big beard and a huge belly. He seems pretty busy and somewhat preoccupied.
npcs.room_description: Leo the portly archwizard is here.

scenery.name: elevator
description: Set into the west wall is an elevator. There is a button next to it, presumably to call the elevator car.

rooms.name: Humpbacked bridge
rooms.description: This is an old, humpbacked bridge. It's seen better days, though it appears still quite stable enough. Some peculiar writing is scrawled on the bridge. The bridge spans a river below. A town is east of here, and a dark forest looms west. There is a small path leading down below the bridge.

scenery.name: cracks
description: The bridge surface has a few cracks, but they seem old and minor...mostly signs of how long the structure has withstood the the elements.

scenery.name: span
description: Below you is a small river with a powerful, swift current. You might be able to climb down the bridge to get to the riverbank below.

scenery.name: town
description: A small town lies east of here.

scenery.name: writing
description: Grafitti is written here, in an odd and uncertain hand, as if unused to the effort of writing.

scenery.name: path
description: West of the bridge is a path going into a dark forest.

rooms.name: A Dark Cave
rooms.description:
This is a small cave at the base of a cliff. A stone door is set into the south wall.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: A Dark Cave
rooms.description: This is a small cave at the base of a cliff. A stone door is set into the north wall.

scenery.name: inscription
description: Words in the language of the elves.

rooms.name: The Healing Chamber
rooms.description: This is the work chamber of Clepius the healer. This is where he performs medical procedures on his customers. A desk in the corner overflows with notes and books. The reception and waiting area is east of here.

npcs.name: a spent firearm slug
description: Clepius is a kindly old man, legendary for his nearly superhuman powers of healing. He is even rumored capable of resurrecting the dead. He runs a medical care service in town, and can be asked to help when needed, though his help is not free.
npcs.room_description: A spent firearm slug is here.

scenery.name: desk
description: This is where Clepius does paperwork and research.

scenery.name: notes
description: These are the contents of the doctor's desk.

scenery.name: corner
description: Location of the desk.

rooms.name: The Village Church
rooms.description:
Decades ago this tiny, one-room church was the center of activity in the village. As the village prospered and secularized, townsfolk attended less and less, until it became dilapidated and abandoned, as you see here. The place is overrun with vermin and cobwebs, but there has been no vandalism. Just dusty neglect. West Village road is south of here, and what looks like an elevator is in the west wall.
There is a button next to the elevator.

scenery.name: elevator
description: Set into the west wall is a thoroughly modern-looking elevator, which seems out of place in this rustic, colonial church. There is a button next to it, presumably to call the elevator car.

scenery.name: road
description: The road is south of here.

scenery.name: wall
description: Set into the west wall is a thoroughly modern-looking elevator, which seems out of place in this rustic, colonial church. There is a button next to it, presumably to call the elevator car.

scenery.name: road
description: The road is south of here.

scenery.name: church
description: An old church.

scenery.name: cobwebs
description: No vermin can presently be seen, but from the cobwebs and dirt it's pretty clear minor pests have made their home here.

scenery.name: vandalism
description: You don't see any of that.

rooms.name: Forest Clearing
rooms.description: This is a small clearing in a path through the forest. The path leads west into a small valley, and northeast toward a forest and a bridge.

scenery.name: clearing
description: An area with few trees.

scenery.name: path
description: This forest path runs east and west. A small trail goes north of here.

scenery.name: forest
description: This is a dark, creepy forest. You are standing on a path in a clearing, so it's a bit brighter here.

scenery.name: small trail
description: A small trail leading into the depths of the forest to the north.

scenery.name: valley
description: A valley is west of here.

scenery.name: town
description: A town, far in the eastern distance.

rooms.name: Town Clerk
rooms.description: This small office is where people come to conduct their official public business. The main area of the town hall is south.

npcs.name: the town clerk
description: An officious-looking clerk. He is empowered to perform ceremonies of public record. You may "ask clerk to marry me and PERSON", and "ask clerk for a divorce".

rooms.name: Conference Room
rooms.description: This is an enchanted room, with the magical power to prevent uninvited people from entering. It is used for meetings where three or more people need to share information without interruption or privately. To enable privacy, 'privacy on'. To disable it, 'privacy off'. The privacy field automatically deactivates after approximately 20 minutes.

npcs.name: cambot
description: This is a metallic sphere, about one foot in diameter, with numerous lenses affixed to its surface.

rooms.name: north of house
rooms.description: The thick woods give way to a small clearing here, where an old house, painted white, stands. The front porch of the house is south. A narrow trail leads into the woods to the north.

scenery.name: forest
description: All around is vegetation growing so incredibly dense that it is impossible to wander off the path.

scenery.name: porch
description: The wooden front porch of an old white house.

scenery.name: trail
description: To the north, a narrow path leads into the woods.

scenery.name: clearing
description: As if by powerful magic, the woods clear here, where the house stands.

scenery.name: house
description: The house looks weatherbeaten, ill maintained, and rather old. Its construction is of an archaic design no longer used. Despite its abused appearance, the house seems to have a quiet dignity about it, as if many people had been its friends over the years, and it simply waited for their return.

rooms.description:

A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Church Elevator
rooms.description: This is the elevator in the village church. The elevator door is on the east wall. Two buttons are set into the wall next to the door, labeled '1' and 'b'.

scenery.name: elevator
description: A means of vertical indoors transportation.

scenery.name: wall
description: The buttons are on the wall.

scenery.name: elevator door
description: The door to the outside.

rooms.name: Forest Path
rooms.description: You are in a forest outside the town. To the southwest the path continues toward a clearing. To the east it leads to a bridge over a river toward a town. Trees and bushes of various kinds border the path making it impossible to go south but to the north the vegetation is less dense.

scenery.name: forest
description: You are on a path in a dark, creepy forest. The vegetation is thick and feels somehow oppressive.

scenery.name: plants
description: The plants, bushes, and trees grow thick and wild here, limiting visibility beyond the path.

scenery.name: bridge
description: An old bridge is east of here.

scenery.name: clearing
description: It looks like there is a clearing in the forest to the west.

scenery.name: path
description: You are on a path in a forest.

rooms.name: The freezer
rooms.description:
The local freezer.  Go down to leave.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Mansion Garden
rooms.description:
This is what is left of what was once a beautiful, if simple, garden. It is now badly overgrown with weeds, and it is clear that foraging animals long ago ate the delicate flowers and vegetables that once grew here. The gardener's shack is north.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: flowers
description: If they were once here, they certainly no longer are.

scenery.name: shack
description: A beaten-up old wooden shack is north.

scenery.name: garden
description: A mess of weeds and dirt.

rooms.name: Mansion Gate
rooms.description: You are standing just north of the gate to a large, beautiful mansion, which stands to the south. The Corinthian capitals on the front pillars bespeak of the wealth and importance of the person who lives here. Lush ivy wraps around the gate and the brick wall surrounding the estate.

npcs.name: a military gate guard
description: This is a military policeman. He has spent months in arduous training, and by the looks of him, has seen plenty of action in his lifetime.  He is large, looks very tough, and whatever he is guarding is probably very safe.
npcs.room_description: A military gate guard is here.

scenery.name: gate
description: A handsome, wrought-iron entry control point.

scenery.name: estate
description: The grounds of a mansion are to the south.

scenery.name: capital
description: These are the headpieces of the pillars supporting the mansion's front overhang. The beautifully detailed carvings of encanthus leaves distinguish them as Corinthian.

scenery.name: overhang
description: A fancy and unnecessary structure in front of the mansion supported by columns.

scenery.name: pillar
description: Load-bearing structures supporting the mansion's front overhang.

scenery.name: ivy
description: Vines of the ivy plant run over and along the walls and gate, so thickly that they nearly obscure them.

scenery.name: wall
description: Architectural features which prevent casual entry. They are made of brick and appear old and strong.

rooms.name: The Healers Guild
rooms.description:
You are in the Healer's Guild. People come here when they have medical problems, and for a price, they are helped. It seems that the doctor's work area is west of here. Saquivor Road is east.
There is a list here you can read.

npcs.name: James, the guild secretary and manager
description: James is typical of apprentice healers: he is a bit arrogant, officious, and brusque; but he appears to be a competent secretary and guild officer.  He is the person you will buy a treatment token from. Read the list on the wall for the tokens available.
npcs.room_description: James, the guild secretary and manager is here.

scenery.name: list
description: A list of available procedures

scenery.name: wall
description: A flat, vertical structure supporting the ceiling.

scenery.name: work area
description: It is west of here.

scenery.name: road
description: The road is outside, east of here.

rooms.name: Healer's Guild Storeroom
rooms.description:
This blank room is where the guild keeps their junk.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: living room
rooms.description: This is the living room of the old house. It is a small, modest home, apparently constructed with an eye toward practicality rather than fanciness. A doorway north leads to the front porch.

scenery.name: forest
description: All around is vegetation growing so incredibly dense that it is impossible to wander off the path.

scenery.name: porch
description: The wooden front porch of an old white house.

scenery.name: trail
description: To the north, a narrow path leads into the woods.

scenery.name: clearing
description: As if by powerful magic, the woods clear here, where the house stands.

scenery.name: house
description: The house looks weatherbeaten, ill maintained, and rather old. Its construction is of an archaic design no longer used. Despite its abused appearance, the house seems to have a quiet dignity about it, as if many people had been its friends over the years, and it simply waited for their return.

rooms.name: The Mages' Guild
rooms.description:
This is the local mage's guild. Here you can ask the guildmaster to let you join, or to teach you spells. For example, you may "ask herkimer to join" or "ask herkimer to teach missile". The magic shop is north.
There is a list of spells you can read.

npcs.name: Herkimer the kind wizard
description: This kindly old wizard is the master of the local magic shop, which doubles as the Mages' Guild. You can ask Herkimer to teach you a spell, and if you're capable of learning it, he will teach you, for a fee. His penetrating blue eyes seem to see right through you, but the smile from beneath his white beard is reassuring.
npcs.room_description: Herkimer the kind wizard is here.

scenery.name: list
description: A list of available spells

rooms.name: The Magic Shop
rooms.description: This is the local magic shop. Magical items can be bought and sold here. The storeroom is upstairs and the town Mages' Guild is south.

npcs.name: Oana the Magic Shop keeper
description: Oana is a sprightly young woman with very short dark hair and a simple, plain manner of dress. She is the Magic Shop keeper, and you may trade in magical items with her.
npcs.room_description: Oana the Magic Shop keeper is here.

scenery.name: store
description: This is the local magic shop.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign on the wall, meant for reading.

rooms.name: The Magic Shop Storeroom
rooms.description: This is the storeroom where magical items are kept.

rooms.name: Downstairs Mansion Hallway
rooms.description: You are in the beautifully decorated downstairs hallway of the mansion. There are rooms to the east and west, and the hallway continues south. To the north is the entrance foyer.

scenery.name: hallway
description: An interior area providing access to other places in the house.

scenery.name: mansion
description: You are in a beautiful mansion.

scenery.name: foyer
description: The mansion's entry area is north of here.

rooms.name: Downstairs Mansion Hallway South
rooms.description: You are in the beautifully decorated downstairs hallway of the mansion. There are rooms to the east and west, and the hallway continues north. A large, circular marble staircase leads up to the second floor.

scenery.name: hallway
description: An interior area providing access to other places in the house.

scenery.name: mansion
description: You are in a beautiful mansion.

scenery.name: stairs
description: A marvelously sculpted series of steps spiraling upward to the second floor. It is carved from marble.

rooms.name: Mansion Exterior
rooms.description: You are standing outside a large, beautiful mansion to the south. It towers over you and overhead you can see one of the second floor windows is open. The grass seems a bit wild around here, and the lawn continues west into an overgrown garden. The mansion gate is north.

scenery.name: house
description: A stately pleasure dome.

scenery.name: window
description: This is an open window, high above you. If you had a ladder, you might be able to climb up enough to enter.

scenery.name: grass
description: Rather unkempt greenery. Looks like the gardener's been on vacation.

scenery.name: gate
description: The entry point into the estate on which you now stand.

rooms.name: Mansion Foyer
rooms.description: This is the foyer of a grand, majestic mansion. Strangely, there is dust everywhere, but the place looks beautiful all the same. A hallway runs south from here.

scenery.name: foyer
description: This is the interior entry area of the mansion, where the front door is.

scenery.name: hall
description: A wide corridor leading south to the rest of the mansion.

scenery.name: dust
description: Tiny particulate material dispersed on visible surfaces.

rooms.name: Mansion Master Bedroom
rooms.description: Mansion Master Bedroom.

scenery.name: decor
description: Impressive, ornate, and beautiful.

rooms.name: Mansion Guest Room East
rooms.description: You are in the east upstairs guest room of the mansion. The room is sumptuously appointed and furnished. The state of the bed suggests that someone has been staying here recently.

scenery.name: furniture
description: Comfortable and attractive.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: This large room is rectangular in shape, and evidently is used as a formal dining room. Beautiful tapestries and paintings decorate the walls, and there is a sense of dignified majesty about this place.

scenery.name: tapestry
description: Fascinating tapestries here apear to document the conquest of Anglia by a Norman king.

scenery.name: painting
description: These are extraordinary oil portraits of renaissance nobility, and they are rendered with an eerily lifelike realism.

rooms.name: Secret Room
rooms.description:
You are in a small, cramped room.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Secret Chamber
rooms.description:
You are in a secret underground chamber beneath the mansion.
A marked archway down returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Mansion Guest Room West
rooms.description: You are in the west upstairs guest room of the mansion. The room is sumptuously appointed and furnished. It looks as though nobody has dusted here in a very long time.

scenery.name: here
description: A guest room in the mansion.

scenery.name: dust
description: There's some dust here, a bit more than one might expect in such a nice place.

rooms.name: Upstairs Bathroom
rooms.description: You are in a bathroom. It is rather ordinary, for such a grand mansion, but it appears quite functional and mostly clean. There is a shower stall here you can enter.

scenery.name: stall
description: A shower stall.

scenery.name: sink
description: An ordinary sink.

rooms.name: Game room
rooms.description: You are in the game room. The walls have been paneled in beautiful oak, and the thick carpeting feels quite nice under your feet.

scenery.name: wall
description: It's beautiful oak paneling, with a deep, rich coat of stain.

scenery.name: carpet
description: It's plush, soft, and very comfortable.

rooms.name: The Study
rooms.description: You are in the study of the master of the house. This room is a shambles! It appears to have been ransacked in great haste. If there ever was anything of value here, it's probably long gone.

rooms.name: Servants' Quarters
rooms.description: You are in the spartan quarters of the on-duty staff. From the lack of personalization, it seems that the servants probably rotate after-hours duty.

rooms.name: kitchen
rooms.description: This is a very large kitchen designed to accommodate dozens of cooks. It looks like nobody has prepared a meal here in quite some time.

rooms.name: Grand Ballroom
rooms.description: This huge room is spectacular both in size and decor. Clearly the centerpiece of the mansion, this ballroom could easily accommodate hundreds of guests. The vaulted ceiling is dozens of feet high, and the polished marble floors feature beautiful, dazzling designs.

rooms.name: Sitting Room
rooms.description: You are in a luxurious sitting room, decorated and furnished with the same excellent taste and attention to detail as the rest of the mansion.

npcs.name: a thief in a bathtowel
description: From his furtive appearance and demeanor, this is obviously a thief who has snuck into the mansion and taken up residence. You seem to have caught him just after his shower.
npcs.room_description: A thief in a bathtowel is here.

scenery.name: furniture
description: You see evidence of a refined aesthetic sensibility.

rooms.name: Upstairs Mansion Hallway North
rooms.description: You are in the beautifully decorated upstairs hallway of the mansion. There are rooms to the east and west, and the hallway continues south. An open window at the end of the hall leads down.

scenery.name: window
description: An open window here leads down to the exterior of the mansion.

scenery.name: hall
description: A corridor permitting travel from one part of the mansion to another.

rooms.name: Upstairs Mansion Hallway
rooms.description: You are in the beautifully decorated upstairs hallway of the mansion. There are rooms to the east and west, and the hallway continues north and south.

scenery.name: hall
description: A corridor permitting travel from one part of the mansion to another.

rooms.name: Upstairs Mansion Hallway South
rooms.description: You are in the beautifully decorated upstairs hallway of the mansion. There are rooms to the east and west, and the hallway continues north. The master bedroom is south. A large, circular marble staircase leads down to the ground floor.

scenery.name: hall
description: A corridor permitting travel from one part of the mansion to another.

rooms.name: Mayor's office
rooms.description:
This is the rather cramped office of the town's mayor. Despite
a fair amount of clutter, it seems well suited to the mayor's 
working style and habits.

npcs.name: the mayor
description: A bit disheveled, this rather eccentric-looking man discharges the official duties of this town's chief executive office. Mostly, people request citizenship from him, for a fee of 5 silver.

scenery.name: clutter
description: There are papers and folders everywhere, but the stacks and piles seem somehow a well-organized mess.

scenery.name: mess
description: Evidence of a busy man and strangely-organized mind.

rooms.name: Fort Road
rooms.description: You are on a road running north and south. To the south is the heart of the town. To the north the road runs along a narrow ridge, leading up to what looks like a fortress. The First Village Bank stands here on the east side of the road. To the west is the post office.

scenery.name: rubble
description: Looks like the road is still being built. Further travel north is impossible.

scenery.name: mountains
description: Beautiful mountains, far off in the northern distance.

rooms.name: a narrow path
rooms.description: This is a narrow path running northeast to a green valley and south through a dense forest. The thick vegetation makes travel off the path impossible.

scenery.name: path
description: A very narrow path that seems threatened all around by the looming woods. It's hard to imagine what force might have cut this thin trail into the vegetation here.

scenery.name: forest
description: All around is vegetation growing so incredibly dense that it is impossible to wander off the path.

rooms.name: a narrow path
rooms.description: This is a narrow path running north and south through a dense forest. The thick vegetation makes travel off the path impossible.

scenery.name: path
description: A very narrow path that seems threatened all around by the looming woods. It's hard to imagine what force might have cut this thin trail into the vegetation here.

scenery.name: forest
description: All around is vegetation growing so incredibly dense that it is impossible to wander off the path.

rooms.name: The Orc Fortress
rooms.description: You find yourself in the entrance of the local orc stronghold. This place seems quite hostile to normal sensibilities, as the construction is rough, inelegant, and the upkeep is squalid. This wooden fort also appears somewhat amateurishly put together, as if done by youngsters playing at being soldiers. There is an exit to the outside south of here, and another room is visible to the west.

npcs.name: a dirty orc
description: This orc is typical of its breed: nasty, brutish, and short. It appears to be a juvenile or adolescent, making it somewhat less dangerous but more hostile.

npcs.name: a dirty orc
description: This orc is typical of its breed: nasty, brutish, and short. It appears to be a juvenile or adolescent, making it somewhat less dangerous but more hostile.

npcs.name: the boss orc
description: This orc is typical of its breed: nasty, brutish, and short. It is larger than the local orcs you've seen, and looks mean and tough.

rooms.name: The Orc Fortress
rooms.description: You are deep in the orc stronghold. Like the rest of the fortress you have seen, this looks hastily put together and rather clumsily built, with poor maintenance besides. This is some kind of ceremonial chamber or temple. Dried blood surrounds a raised altar, and skulls of various types adorn the walls. The rest of the fort is east of here.

npcs.name: the orc shaman
description: This orc is different from the others you've seen. he has an unearthly ferocity about him and is bigger, tougher, and meaner than the others.

scenery.name: skull
description: You see some skulls whose race you recognize, but most you don't. There is at least one human skull here. Some of them are so fresh they are still wet and have tissue hanging from them.

scenery.name: chamber
description: A place where orcish rituals are performed.

scenery.name: blood
description: Evidently the ground around the altar has collected blood from whatever happens on the altar.

scenery.name: wall
description: Rough-hewn walls of earth and wood.

rooms.name: front porch
rooms.description: This is the rickety front porch of an old house. The front door is south. To the north is a clearing in the woods, and a path leading away.

scenery.name: forest
description: All around is vegetation growing so incredibly dense that it is impossible to wander off the path.

scenery.name: porch
description: The wooden front porch of an old white house.

scenery.name: trail
description: To the north, a narrow path leads into the woods.

scenery.name: clearing
description: As if by powerful magic, the woods clear here, where the house stands.

scenery.name: house
description: The house looks weatherbeaten, ill maintained, and rather old. Its construction is of an archaic design no longer used. Despite its abused appearance, the house seems to have a quiet dignity about it, as if many people had been its friends over the years, and it simply waited for their return.

rooms.name: the town post office
rooms.description: This is a small office containing rows of mailboxes and various other postal implements. There is a sign on the wall behind the counter, outlining instructions for how to mail other users. Fort road is east of here.

scenery.name: box
description: Rows of mailboxes for the denizens of Frontiers.

scenery.name: sign
description: This is a sign on the wall describing how to mail messages.

scenery.name: wall
description: Gray-painted institutional walls of the kind you'd expect in a post office.

scenery.name: implements
description: Ink, paper, etc.

scenery.name: instructions
description: Try reading them.

scenery.name: counter
description: A counter folks use to lean on while writing messages.

rooms.name: riverbank
rooms.description:
This is the bank of a narrow but swift-moving river. A steep path leads back up to the bridge. There is a cave in the steep east wall of the riverbank.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

npcs.name: a mean-looking troll
description: This is the dreaded creature of legend: a slimy, green, putrid-looking fiend with long, razor-sharp claws and fangs.

rooms.name: North Saquivor Road
rooms.description: You are on Saquivor road, leading north-south through the village. To the east is the village pub, the legendary watering hole used by thousands of rogues, paladins, and everyone in between. The Healers' Guild is west, and to the north you can see a road leading up to the plateau where the Fortress on the Frontiers stands. To the south is a major intersection.

scenery.name: pub
description: The is the town's legendary watering hole, where refreshments are served and tall tales are swapped.

scenery.name: guild
description: In this building is the office of the only doctor in town.

scenery.name: clouds
description: Little puffy clouds surround the peaks of the northern mountains.

scenery.name: northern mountains
description: Majestic mountains are far to the north, seeming almost purple from here.

scenery.name: intersection
description: The main town crossroads is south.

rooms.name: Saquivor Road
rooms.description: This is Saquivor road, leading north-south through the village. A bit further north are what look like a pub and some kind of guild. To the south is a major intersection.

npcs.name: a dirty beggar
description: This beggar has something strangely noble about his aspect. He certainly doesn't look like he has always been a beggar.

scenery.name: pub
description: The is the town's legendary watering hole, where refreshments are served and tall tales are swapped.

scenery.name: guild
description: In this building is the office of the only doctor in town.

scenery.name: clouds
description: Little puffy clouds surround the peaks of the northern mountains.

scenery.name: northern mountains
description: Majestic mountains are far to the north, seeming almost purple from here.

scenery.name: intersection
description: The main town crossroads is south.

rooms.name: West Village road
rooms.description: This is a well-traveled road, leading east into town and west away from it. The town church is north.

rooms.name: West Village road
rooms.description: This is a well-traveled road, leading east into town and west away from it. An old, humpbacked bridge is west of here. A grand mansion is south.

scenery.name: fort
description: It can't be seen well from here, but far north is what appears to be a large fortress built on a high plateau.

scenery.name: road
description: This is a simple east-west road that goes east into town and west away from it. Another road, paved with cobblestones, intersects here to the north and leads high toward a fortress in the distance.

scenery.name: cobblestone road
description: This is where a cobblestone road begins that is built on an steep incline and rises up as it leads north to a high plateau.

rooms.name: a generic place
rooms.description:
This is an utterly plain, blank place.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Village Schoolhouse
rooms.description: This simple, one-room schoolhouse is not especially large but it is clean, well-maintained, and clearly an important part of village life. People come here to be taught, mostly languages, by traveling teachers and guest lecturers.

npcs.name: Bugg the schoolteacher
description: This is a person whose job it is to teach you things. For example, 'ask teacher to teach Malkierien' would prompt him to begin teaching a Malkierien lesson to you, if he knows the language and you have earned sufficient training points. If you lack training points, then do some adventuring and earn a level promotion. You will then be awarded training points. To know more about what Bugg can teach: ask bugg for help

rooms.name: the secret stash
rooms.description:
This appears to be a secret room for saving valuables. The master bedroom is west.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Gardener's Shack
rooms.description: This is the dark, wooden shack of the keeper of the garden. From the dust and rust, it is obvious nobody has done much gardening around here lately.

rooms.name: The General Store
rooms.description: This is the local general store. You can buy or sell items here. A sign on the wall hangs here, explaining how things work. Try 'read sign'. East Village Road is south of here. The storeroom is below.

npcs.name: Otik, the keeper of the shop
description: Otik is the owner of the local general store, an old and famous trading post in the heart of town.  The brother of Lars, he also is an unassuming fellow, and just as jovial.
npcs.room_description: Otik, the keeper of the shop is here.

scenery.name: store
description: This is the local store.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign on the wall, meant for reading.

rooms.name: Otik's storage room
rooms.description: This is a small, bare room where Otik keeps his goods. The main store is above.

rooms.name: Shore Edge
rooms.description:
You are on the shore, at the far eastern end of town. A road travels west into the heart of town. A great sea stretches out into the eastern horizon. 
There is a sign here you can read.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign on the ground. To read it, 'read sign'.

scenery.name: ground
description: The local surface.

scenery.name: horizon
description: Where the sky loves the sea.

scenery.name: town
description: A population center to the west.

scenery.name: road
description: Leads west, to the town.

rooms.name: Shower Stall
rooms.description:
You are standing in a shower stall. People come here to get clean.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: a dark tunnel
rooms.description:
This tunnel has very smooth stone walls and leads east. There is also an opening in the ceiling above.
A marked archway down returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: hole
description: These holes appear to be where spring water enters to flood the chamber and fill the well east of here.

scenery.name: dirt
description: There's plenty of that here. Empty wells rarely get much priority on cleaning day.

scenery.name: bottom
description: Dirty, musty, and unpleasant.

scenery.name: vermin
description: Looks like they're hiding from you at the moment.

scenery.name: haven
description: A nice place for vermin.

scenery.name: rock
description: This is dense, hard stuff deep underground.

rooms.name: Saquivor Road
rooms.description:
This is a cobblestone road, leading north into town and south away from it. The magic shop is to the west. 
An old well stands by the side of the road.

scenery.name: well
description: This looks like the sort of system used to provide water before the town implemented more modern waterworks. It looks long dry and abandoned.

scenery.name: bank
description: The First Village Bank

scenery.name: road
description: A cobblestone road running north and south.

rooms.name: South Saquivor Road
rooms.description: This is a cobblestone road, leading north into town and south away from it. South of here appears to be some sort of University campus.

scenery.name: road
description: A cobblestone road, running north and south.

scenery.name: sign
description: A large sign on the road. To read it, 'read sign'.

scenery.name: grate
description: A grate that seems to lead into sewers. It can't be opened from here.

rooms.name: Village Stables
rooms.description: These are the village stables. Townsfolk come here and leave their mounts in the care of Ingrid, the local horse girl. The place is orderly, if a bit stinky, and it's clear Ingrid runs a professional outfit.

npcs.name: Ingrid
description: Ingrid is rather slight of build, but has a non-nonsense way about her that makes her seem much tougher than she physically looks.

npcs.name: a large horse
description: A large, hooved quadruped, taller and more muscular than you. Perhaps if you befriend him, he'll allow you to mount him.

scenery.name: building
description: A small but well-kept wooden building where townsfolk and their children go to acquire knowledge.

scenery.name: building
description: Structures designed for human occupancy.

rooms.name: The Local Tavern
rooms.description:
You are in the local pub. You can order drinks and a sandwich here:

	First class ale:				10 silver
	Special of the house:				20 silver
	Firebreather:					50 silver
	Spring water:					2 silver
	Regular coffee:					5 silver
	Imported espresso:				15 silver
	Ham sandwich:					10 silver


To order a bottle of water, "buy water from lars"

There is a framed portrait on the wall.

npcs.name: Lars, the keeper of the pub
description: Lars is the owner of the local pub, an old and famous drinking establishment in the heart of town.  He is an unassuming fellow, and quite jovial.
npcs.room_description: Lars, the keeper of the pub is here.

scenery.name: portrait
description: It is a dramatic portrait of an ancient dragon of immense beauty and grace. It is titled "Daelas: Heir of Arodaleas".

rooms.name: Town Hall
rooms.description: This is the modest foyer of this village's Town Hall. It's a simple affair, really, in keeping with the down-to-earth spirit of the town. The office of the clerk and notary is north, and the Mayor's office is upstairs. Village road is south. The registrar of voters is northeast.

rooms.name: the training area
rooms.description: You are in a large room with a very high ceiling, mirrored walls, and a hardwood floor. This area is designed for skills training, though at the moment no workshops are scheduled. The rest of the Adventurers' Guild is downstairs.

npcs.name: Radagast the Brown
description: This is a tall, thin old man. Not much is known of this mysterious wizard, other than his legendary kindness to animals and his controversial reputation as a seditious rebel. He can train you in the arts of magic defense, magic attack, and conjuring. You may, for example, "ask radagast to train conjuring". If you lack training points, then do some adventuring and earn a promotion from Dirk. You will then be awarded training points.

scenery.name: wall
description: The walls have mirrors set into them.

scenery.name: mirror
description: Peekaboo!

scenery.name: hardwoord floor
description: The floor is made of polished wood, and is reminiscent of what you might expect in a dancing school.

scenery.name: ceiling
description: The high, vaulted ceiling provides plenty of headroom.

rooms.name: Orc Valley
rooms.description: You are in a small valley below the sheer cliffs to the west. A band of orcs appears to have made this place their home, and you can see their ramshackle fortress toward the north. A well-traveled path leads east into a forest. A narrow path snakes its way southwest into the woods.

npcs.name: a dirty orc
description: This orc is typical of its breed: nasty, brutish, and short. It appears to be a juvenile or adolescent, making it somewhat less dangerous but more hostile.

npcs.name: a dirty orc
description: This orc is typical of its breed: nasty, brutish, and short. It appears to be a juvenile or adolescent, making it somewhat less dangerous but more hostile.

rooms.name: Village Road Intersection
rooms.description:
You are in the main intersection of the village. Saquivor road extends north and south, intersected east to west by a road that leads west toward a wilderness, and east toward shore.
There is a sign here you can read.

scenery.name: sign
description: A large sign on the road. To read it, 'read sign'.

rooms.name: East Village Road
rooms.description: You are on a long road. The general store is north. The road stretches east and west through the town. The Adventurers' Guild is south.

scenery.name: adventurers guild
description: This small building on the southern side of the road is where adventurers, great and small, come to record their exploits and seek advancement.

scenery.name: shop
description: This is the general store, where almost anything can be bought or sold.

scenery.name: road
description: An east-west cobblestone road through town.

rooms.name: East Village Road
rooms.description: A long road going through the village. Town Hall is north. The main part of the town is west of here.

scenery.name: office
description: Mail can be received and sent from the post office.

scenery.name: building
description: Structures designed for human occupancy.

scenery.name: hall
description: This is the modest building where official town business takes place.

rooms.name: Village Path
rooms.description: As it travels from west to east, Village Road becomes less of a road here and more of a dirt path. The shore of the eastern sea is almost visible from here. The village schoolhouse is north, and the shore is east. The village stables are south.

scenery.name: building
description: A small but well-kept wooden building where townsfolk and their children go to acquire knowledge.

scenery.name: building
description: Structures designed for human occupancy.

scenery.name: shore
description: The shore of the eastern sea is east of here.

rooms.name: the void
rooms.description:
The void.  Go down to get out.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Registrar of Voters
rooms.description: This small office is where people come to perform their civic duty of voting. Here you may also 'nominate CANDIDATE'. There is a list of candidates here. The main area of the town hall is southwest.

scenery.name: list
description: This is the list of candidates.

rooms.name: Town Well
rooms.description: Town Well.

rooms.name: Water Tunnel
rooms.description: This dark tunnel appears roughly carved into the bedrock, and slopes downward to the west. It seems as though this is the way for an underground spring to feed the town well. The tunnel ends in doors at both the east and west.

scenery.name: rock
description: This is dense, hard stuff deep underground.

rooms.name: Dry Spring
rooms.description: This small, dark chamber appears to have been carved out of the bedrock, and contains a hole bored into the floor. Considering the difficulty of digging into such solid stuff, this wellwater system must have taken a fortune and a vast amount of labor to construct. A door leads east to the water tunnel and the well.

scenery.name: hole
description: This hole appears to be where spring water enters to flood the chamber and fill the well east of here.

scenery.name: dirt
description: There's plenty of that here. Empty wells rarely get much priority on cleaning day.

scenery.name: bottom
description: Dirty, musty, and unpleasant.

scenery.name: vermin
description: Looks like they're hiding from you at the moment.

scenery.name: haven
description: A nice place for vermin.
